title: anapeltis owariensis
intro: Anapeltis owariensis, commonly known as the "African birthwort," is a plant species that belongs to the Aristolochiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in West African folk medicine, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, which include the relief of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Anapeltis owariensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Anapeltis owariensis include alkaloids, such as aristolochic acid and aristolochine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
